services.gx10-langgraph-api:
[Unit]
Description=GX10 local LangGraph experimental API
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/home/lain/projects/datalog-research/benchmark/gx10-langgraph
Environment="PATH=/home/lain/.local/opt/node-v24.22.1-linux-arm64/bin:/home/lain/.local/opt/langgraph-pi/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
Environment="PYTHONPATH=/home/lain/projects/datalog-research/benchmark/gx10-langgraph"
Environment="LANGSMITH_TRACING=false"
Environment="LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2=false"
Environment="LANGSMITH_API_KEY="
Environment="LANGCHAIN_API_KEY="
Environment="LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1"
Environment="LANGGRAPH_API_NO_USAGE_STATS=true"
Environment="OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true"
Environment="DO_NOT_TRACK=1"
Environment="HARBOR_TELEMETRY=0"
Environment="PI_TELEMETRY=0"
Environment="ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=false"
ExecStart="/home/lain/.local/opt/langgraph-pi/bin/langgraph" "dev" "--config" "/home/lain/projects/datalog-research/benchmark/gx10-langgraph/langgraph.json" "--host" "127.0.0.1" "--port" "2024" "--no-reload" "--no-browser" "--n-jobs-per-worker" "1" "--allow-blocking"
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStopSec=30
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
